node_kinds.name: CH_Cluster
node_kinds.description: The target Kubernetes cluster. Convergence point for cluster-wide attack paths.

node_kinds.name: CH_ExternalActor
node_kinds.description: Synthetic unauthenticated external threat actor. Source of unauthenticated access edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_Node
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes worker or control plane node.

node_kinds.name: CH_Namespace
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes namespace. Target for namespace-scoped RBAC edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_Pod
node_kinds.description: Running Kubernetes pod. Source of host escape, service account compromise, and volume edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_Workload
node_kinds.description: Pod-creating workload controller: Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, ReplicaSet, ReplicationController, Job, or CronJob.

node_kinds.name: CH_Service
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Service. Source of entryPoint edges to matching pods.

node_kinds.name: CH_Secret
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes Secret. Target of secretsRead edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_Identity
node_kinds.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount, User, or Group. Source of all RBAC-derived attack edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_Volume
node_kinds.description: Pod volume mount. Target of hasReadVolume and hasWriteVolume edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_Role
node_kinds.description: Namespaced Kubernetes RBAC Role. Target of bindsRole edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_ClusterRole
node_kinds.description: Cluster-scoped Kubernetes RBAC ClusterRole. Target of bindsRole edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_RoleBinding
node_kinds.description: Namespaced RBAC binding. Source of bindsRole edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_ClusterRoleBinding
node_kinds.description: Cluster-scoped RBAC binding. Source of bindsRole edges.

node_kinds.name: CH_IMDSService
node_kinds.description: Cloud provider instance metadata endpoint (AWS, Azure, GCP). Target of accessIMDS edges.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_fullAccess
relationship_kinds.description: Identity holds wildcard RBAC permissions (*/*) granting unrestricted access to a namespace or the entire cluster.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_nodesProxyRCE
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has nodes/proxy GET permission, enabling proxied requests to the Kubelet API and RCE on any node.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_unauthAPIAccess
relationship_kinds.description: Kubernetes API server may accept unauthenticated requests (--anonymous-auth). Requires manual verification.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_unauthKubeletAccess
relationship_kinds.description: Kubelet API may be accessible without authentication. Requires manual verification.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_podPrivileged
relationship_kinds.description: Pod runs with privileged: true, providing a direct path to the underlying node on container compromise.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_podHostPID
relationship_kinds.description: Pod shares the host PID namespace, exposing all host processes and enabling credential harvesting from /proc.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_podHostNetwork
relationship_kinds.description: Pod shares the host network namespace, enabling traffic sniffing and network policy bypass.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_podHostIPC
relationship_kinds.description: Pod shares the host IPC namespace, enabling access to host shared memory segments.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canExec
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has pods/exec permission enabling direct command execution in running containers.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canCreate
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can create Pods or pod-creating workload controllers, enabling deployment of arbitrary pod specs.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canPatch
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has patch/update permissions on Pods or workload controllers, enabling image replacement or spec modification.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canCreateEphemeral
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has pods/ephemeralcontainers update permission, enabling injection of ephemeral debug containers.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canAttach
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has pods/attach permission, enabling attachment to running container processes.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canPortForward
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has pods/portforward permission, enabling tunnelling into Pod network stacks for lateral movement.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canBind
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can create or modify RoleBindings or ClusterRoleBindings, enabling privilege assignment.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canEscalate
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has the escalate verb, allowing creation of roles with permissions beyond their own.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canImpersonate
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has impersonate permissions, allowing API requests to be made as other users, groups, or service accounts.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_canCreateToken
relationship_kinds.description: Identity can mint tokens for ServiceAccounts via the TokenRequest API.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_secretsRead
relationship_kinds.description: Identity has get or list permissions on Secrets, exposing full secret values.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_compromiseServiceAccount
relationship_kinds.description: Pod mounts a ServiceAccount token, allowing an attacker who controls the pod to use that identity.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_entryPoint
relationship_kinds.description: Service selector matches a running Pod, representing a potential external or internal access path into the cluster.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_accessIMDS
relationship_kinds.description: Pod can potentially reach the cloud provider instance metadata endpoint. Requires verification.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_hasWriteVolume
relationship_kinds.description: Pod has a writable volume mount, potentially allowing modification of sensitive data or binaries.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_hasReadVolume
relationship_kinds.description: Pod has a readable volume mount, potentially exposing sensitive data.

relationship_kinds.name: CH_bindsRole
relationship_kinds.description: Structural edge linking a RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding to the Role or ClusterRole it references.
